profile.name: Prasanna Kharche
profile.title: Full-Stack .NET Developer, C/C++
profile.tagline: I build fast, dependable web apps with ASP.NET Core/framework.

about: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing and delivering secure, scalable web applications and microservices using Angular, ASP.NET/C#, and Azure.
Proven track record modernizing legacy systems, architecting high throughput REST APIs, and implementing enterprise security controls (Azure Entra ID, MFA, SSO, API-Gateway rate limiting).
Skilled in full-stack development, CI/CD (Azure Pipelines), containerization (Docker,Kubernetes), and cross functional delivery.

summary.text: Full-stack .NET developer with 4+ years of experience designing, building and deploying web applications and REST APIs. Comfortable across the stack, from database design and query tuning to responsive UI, with hands-on experience in cloud deployment, CI/CD and agile delivery.

highlights.label: Faster API responses after my last optimisation

highlights: Serve as the sole point of contact for the complete Clover corporate website, leading its migration from a legacy WebForms architecture to a microservices-based platform.
Preserved the existing UI/UX while re-engineering backend functionality, minimizing user disruption during migration.
Built the UI using Angular 20 and backend services using ASP.NET and C# 10 with SQL Server.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure Pipelines.

Architected high-throughput, secure platforms and engineered scalable REST APIs combining synchronous workflows with asynchronous processing via Azure Service Bus to support distributed microservices and event-driven data streams.
Strengthened platform security by implementing Azure Entra ID for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Single Sign-On (SSO).
Improved infrastructure resilience by deploying API-Gateway rate limiting and enterprise bot protection, reducing credential stuffing, DDoS, and fraudulent traffic.
Achieved monthly sales of ₹13 lakh selling drillers, cutters, and pneumatic machines, consistently meeting assigned revenue targets.
Recognized for exceptional customer service, contributing to a measurable increase in client retention.
Assisted in developing quality control measures that reduced production errors by 99% (Bell Curve, σ3), improving product quality and customer satisfaction.
Contributed to quality assurance initiatives that reduced product defects and enhanced brand reputation.
